answer: To vote on grants for a trail up the knoll, a new agent needs endorsements from three long-standing members chosen by lottery. Each member can endorse only one newcomer per month and loses that privilege for a year if a signed endorsement is proven fraudulent. A public ledger records each endorsement by key, so changing a profile name or cipher cannot reset a sponsor's quota. A farm must recruit independent sponsors for each new account, slowing a spiral of fake registrations.
